_description: Pen names used on the site. No photos, no personal details: a name, a beat, and a short description. Posts reference authors by key in their `author` field; build.py renders bylines, /authors/<key>.html pages and Person schema without an image.

marcus.name: Marcus Vale
marcus.bio: Marcus covers the consoles, handhelds and PC hardware of the 90s and 2000s: what they cost, why they won or lost, and what became of the companies that built them.

dana.name: Dana Reyes
dana.beat: The dot-com era and internet culture
dana.bio: Dana covers the dot-com era: the companies, the deals and the websites that shaped the early internet, and what actually happened to them after the headlines moved on.

theo.name: Theo Lindqvist
theo.beat: Software, formats and the then-versus-now math
theo.bio: Theo covers the software, file formats and everyday gadgets of the era, and does the then-versus-now math on what things cost, how fast they were, and what replaced them.
